DSC_0019.jpg.title: River Crossing
DSC_0019.jpg.description: I almost fell down a steep hill trying to get this. It was worth it. 5:37 PM
DSC_0019.jpg.alt: A person crossing a shallow creek surrounded by dense green trees and gravel bars.

DSC_0024.jpg.title: Quiet Bend
DSC_0024.jpg.description: I waited until a car crossed the bridge. It looked empty without one. 5:41 PM
DSC_0024.jpg.alt: Calm river with a bridge in the distance and a lone person standing near the far shoreline.

DSC_0025.jpg.title: Deck View
DSC_0025.jpg.description: By the time karaoke starts, some of these chairs are gone. 5:41 PM
DSC_0025.jpg.alt: Wooden deck with colorful chairs overlooking a grassy riverbank and trees.

DSC_0049.jpg.title: Riverside at Dusk
DSC_0049.jpg.description: Maybe you can't tell by the photo, but Riverside Grocery has amazing catfish. 5:41 PM
DSC_0049.jpg.alt: Gas station canopy at dusk with illuminated lights and parked vehicles beneath.

DSC_0051.jpg.title: Self Service
DSC_0051.jpg.description: I've never understood why this is the only pump that isn't under the canopy. 8:02 PM
DSC_0051.jpg.alt: Single vintage-style gas pump standing alone in a nearly empty parking lot at dusk.

DSC_0071.jpg.title: Sunset Over Highway Five
DSC_0071.jpg.description: I ran across a busy highway for a shot from the other side, and then it was out of focus. But I think this one looked better anyways. 8:18 PM
DSC_0071.jpg.alt: Highway bridge stretching into the distance beneath a colorful sunset sky.

DSC_0072.jpg.title: Thursday Karaoke
DSC_0072.jpg.description: This guy really knows how to get the crowd going. 8:25 PM
DSC_0072.jpg.alt: Karaoke singer performing on stage while the DJ and audience watch.

DSC_0079.jpg.title: In the Spotlight
DSC_0079.jpg.description: She really knows what she's doing. Am I saying that because she's good, or because she's my mom? Both. 8:31 PM
DSC_0079.jpg.alt: Woman singing into a microphone under colorful stage lighting during an outdoor karaoke event.

DSC_0093.jpg.title: Gas Prices
DSC_0093.jpg.description: I can't imagine how long this sign has been standing here. 8:39 PM
DSC_0093.jpg.alt: Illuminated roadside business sign beside a dark highway at night.
